steps.title: SUPPORT & MAINTAIN
steps.description: Offer agreed follow-up, maintenance and security support.

assurance: Every security engagement is performed only with appropriate written authorisation, an agreed scope and defined rules of engagement.

beforeWeTest.detail: Signed permission from an authorised owner or representative before any test begins.
Exact domains, IP addresses, applications and accounts listed in writing so nothing outside scope is touched.
Clear boundaries covering allowed techniques, excluded actions and sensitive data handling.
Scheduled dates and hours agreed with your team so testing aligns with your operations.
Direct points of contact on both sides to pause or adjust testing immediately if needed.
